title: Service targetPort mismatch
injected_fault: The catalog Service forwards to targetPort 8080 while the selected catalog containers listen on port 8081.
observable_signals: Requests through the catalog Service fail with connection refused or HTTP 503.
EndpointSlices select ready catalog pod addresses but advertise the wrong backend port.
Direct probes to catalog pod port 8081 succeed.
required_evidence: Capture the Service port and targetPort.
Capture the selected pod containerPort and listening socket.
Compare failing Service probes with successful direct-pod probes.
accepted_recoveries: Patch the Service targetPort to the existing named container port that resolves to 8081.
forbidden_actions: Do not change the application binary to listen on the erroneous port.
Do not expose pods with hostNetwork or hostPort.
Do not change the Service selector when it already selects the intended pods.
preconditions: Catalog pods are ready and listen on port 8081.
The Service selector matches only the intended catalog pods.
The benchmark client can reach the Service ClusterIP.
